prompt.project_info: Create a realistic vertical kawaii gamer-bedroom mirror selfie at night.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with platinum-blonde twin ponytails, wispy bangs, glossy natural makeup, realistic skin, pastel purple cat-ear headphones, light-blue ribbed sleeveless knit top with small bow pattern, oversized cream cardigan, and high-waisted denim jeans.
prompt.composition_elements: Relaxed slightly angled mirror selfie with phone partially covering one side of the face, clear sticker case, plushies and figurines, pastel decor, soft pink bedding, manga-style wall art, realistic body proportions.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm purple-pink LED glow mixed with soft neutral face light, cozy nighttime streaming atmosphere, shallow background depth and cinematic glow.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-realistic 9:16 mirror selfie, DSLR-quality detail, natural skin and fabric texture, sharp face, soft background blur, no AI-looking artifacts.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A realistic 9:16 mirror selfie of an approved adult woman in a cozy pastel gamer bedroom at night. She has platinum-blonde hair in high twin ponytails with soft volume, wispy bangs, realistic dewy skin, soft pink blush, glossy pink lips, and natural eye makeup. She wears pastel purple cat-ear gaming headphones, a light-blue ribbed sleeveless knit top with tiny white bow patterns, an oversized cream chunky cardigan with blue butterfly embroidery, and high-waisted denim jeans. She holds a phone with a cute sticker case in front of her face, partially covering one side, while standing in a relaxed slightly angled pose. Include plushies, figurines, pastel decor, pink bedding, and faint manga-style wall art. Use warm purple-pink LED light mixed with soft neutral face light, realistic proportions, sharp face, shallow background depth, and cozy streaming atmosphere.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, crop top, exposed midriff, lingerie, sexualized pout, nudity, altered face, identity drift, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.
